name: Bank of America Corporation
monetization: Lends to and seeks capital-markets mandates from AI issuers; extended OpenAI's first bilateral bank credit line ($520M, Jul 2026) while pursuing IPO advisory roles at OpenAI and Anthropic.
description_md: Bank of America is one of the large US banks moving from the sidelines into direct AI-lab credit exposure. After declining OpenAI's financing requests a year earlier, it opened a $520M bilateral credit line in July 2026 — widely read as relationship-building ahead of OpenAI's planned IPO. Bank C&I exposure to AI-adjacent industries is a live contagion channel (Chicago Fed: ~25% of Tier 1 capital in commitments across the banking system).

observations.notes: First bilateral bank loan to OpenAI; drawn amount undisclosed.
